scope: The pre-agreed PPO stability requirement after the first full pass under protocol2. No rollback or early termination on quality failure.
baseline_reuse: Read the completed150-case table once, preserve exact cases, never rerun the source model.
conditions: Restore all learner, optimizer, random-generator and environment state; retain scene order and2updates per scene. Same production Trainer.update,3D action, reward, sensors, network, optimizer and physical task. No continuation hyperparameter change.
gates: Every check:25 episodes per primary scene,>=23 successes in each,>=95% of the original successful cases retained (at least143/150). All checks must pass; actual final model172 is retained and is the future independent-test candidate.
artifacts: Per-update metrics; per-check CSV/report; all complete learner states and actor exports; final status and aggregate pass flag.
independence: Automatic initial benchmark at2million is separate from the future final frozen test. Final testing will use a separately reserved new cohort after a stable three-seed recipe; no test data enter learning.
